mines.mine_notes: 100%-owned underground gold project in Rouyn-Noranda, Québec. 2026 FS (announced June 17, 2026; post-dates the reporting period, cited as most current): 15-year LOM, 15,800 tpd SAG+ball mill plant, pre-production capex C$1.75B; avg annual payable gold 220,300 oz; AISC US$782/oz; after-tax NPV5% C$3.35B, IRR 28.2%, payback 3.3 yr at US$3,600/oz Au; spot case (May 31, 2026 prices) NPV5% C$5.1B, IRR 37.2%. 2021 FS comparison: after-tax NPV5% C$974.2M, IRR 18.9%, AISC US$586/oz. Reserves unchanged in tonnage from 2017/2021 FS (metal prices updated). Environmental review advancing (Québec Ministry written confirmation); OLIA with Glencore Canada for property access since Jan 2024.
